executive_summary: Gopi, a poor young artist, receives a magic paintbrush that brings everything he paints to life. He paints plows and tools for poor villagers. A greedy Zamindar captures Gopi and forces him to paint a golden palace and treasure. Gopi refuses to serve tyranny and paints a vast ocean and a storm that sinks the Zamindar's ship, freeing the village.
